title: Scaena spine projection
description: The spine projection: `export --format spine` writes it; `spine_read` returns it without timing or renders.

scaena.description: The format of the deck it was projected from: its `scaena`.

lang.description: The deck's language (BCP 47), for a voice that reads it.

canvas.description: The deck's canvas, in canvas units: width and height.

formats.description: The formats the deck lists (SPEC §3.4), as it names them: `16:9`, `9:16`. A beat has a render in each whose canvas is not the deck's own.

spine.description: The spine as the deck holds it; absent if it has none.

pace.description: How the timeline its states and beats are placed on was paced (`Pace`). Given the timeline.

beats.description: Every beat, by id, in spine order.

Id.description: A slug: unique within its collection (SPEC §3.2).

claim.description: One sentence the audience should leave with.

notes.description: Speaker notes: what a presenter reads for each state it names that has none of its own (SPEC §2.6).

duration.description: Estimated seconds: what a video and the spine give its states with no `hold`, less their cues (SPEC §2.4).

Pace.description: How a projection paces the deck's global timeline (SPEC §2.4, §10).

oneOf.description: Each state its `hold`; where it has none, its share of its beat's `duration`, less the cues of the beat's states (`paced`): a talk timed as it is given, though a player waits on the presenter.
Each state its `hold` alone, as a player auto-advances: a state with none comes to rest and goes on at once.

SpineState.description: A state: its slide, its notes, and where it plays.

notes.description: What a presenter reads for it (SPEC §2.6, `notes`): its own notes, else its beat's. None where nothing is written on it.

hold.description: Its dwell at rest, ms, as the deck gives it.

rest.description: Its time at rest on the timeline, ms: its `hold`, or under `pace: beats`, where it has none, its share of its beat's `duration` (`paced`). Given the timeline.

start.description: When its transition starts on the global timeline, ms. Given the timeline.

span.description: Its cue, ms: its transition and motions. Its hold follows. Given the timeline.

SpineBeat.description: A beat: the state that shows it, when it plays, and its renders.

state.description: The state that shows it: the last of its states in the deck's order. None if it names no state of the deck.

start.description: When it starts on the global timeline, ms: where its first state starts. Given the timeline.

end.description: When it ends, ms: where its last state's hold ends. Given the timeline.

thumbnail.description: `state` at rest, small, in the deck's own format: a path relative to the projection's file. Once drawn.

formats.description: `state` at rest in each of the deck's other formats, at that format's canvas size: paths relative to the projection's file, by format. Once drawn.
